audience: marketing and sales teams that host videos on Vidyard players and hubs

useCases.title: Find players by name, tag or description
useCases.text: Search players by name, UUID, description, tags or internal notes. Read the settings and tags of one player.

useCases.title: Check which videos are still encoding
useCases.text: List videos and read the encoding status of each one. Check the current length of a video that is still in progress.

useCases.title: Review hubs and the users in the account
useCases.text: List the hubs, which are branded video pages, and the users of the account. Filter the users by team.

useCases.title: Rename a player or change its description
useCases.text: Change the name or description of one player. Other fields are left as they are.

useCases.title: Tag a player for a campaign
useCases.text: Create a tag and attach it to a player or uploader widget. Check the existing tags of the player first.
